findings.note: Added `if (ariaLabelledBy) quill.root.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', ariaLabelledBy)` inside the onLoad callback in Editor.tsx where the quill instance is guaranteed to be initialised.
Expanded the useEffect guard to an if/else block that calls removeAttribute when ariaLabelledBy is falsy, matching the attribute lifecycle to the prop lifecycle.

Replaced hardcoded 'workflow-execution-prompt-label' string with `const labelId = useId()` (React 18 built-in) in WorkflowStartExecutionPopup.tsx; both the label's id and ariaLabelledBy now receive the same stable-per-instance value.
Removed `?? ''` fallback from the Editor mock in the accessibility test; aria-labelledby is now passed as-is so React omits the attribute when the prop is undefined, matching real Editor behaviour.
